key: # One setting per row: key = its name (do not change it); value = what you may edit; notes = what it does.

notes: The public web address, used for share links, the sitemap and link previews in local builds. On GitHub the address comes from the SITE_URL repository variable (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → Variables) or, if that is not set, from the GitHub Pages address.
The current panel number. Change it (and panel_years and previous_panel) when the panel rotates: menus, headings and the link-preview picture follow.
The two years of the current panel.
All times on the site are shown in this time zone.
The Area's Google Calendar (MSCA09). Every meeting and event on the site comes from it.

Leave empty: set the repository secret DRIVE_FOLDER_ID instead (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → Secrets) — the folder id is not published, and a secret is masked in the build logs. It is the id of the Area's shared Google Drive folder that holds documents and flyers; only the automatic Drive listing (with GOOGLE_API_KEY) uses it.

The webmaster's address: where site problems and posting requests go. Every page that says to write to the webmaster shows it (the Web Servant, Mack P., at the owner's request of 2026-11-18; it was webmaster@msca09aa.org). The footer shows email_footer instead. When it changes, also change the copies typed out in data/committees.csv (technology: email_other), the Technology FAQ in data/committee-resources.csv (English and Spanish) and the Web Servant row in data/trusted-servants.csv.

The e-mail address in the footer of every page, and the Area's contact address for search engines (the Organization markup). Since 2026-11-18 the Technology Chair's role mailbox, at the owner's request.

The Area Guidelines and Bylaws linked on the About page (Who we are → Area Guidelines & Bylaws): document ids from data/documents/current.csv, separated by ;. The English and Spanish copies of one document share a row. When a new revision is approved, add it to the library and put its ids here in place of the old ones.
Web login page of the Area's @msca09aa.org mailboxes. The footer links to it below the footer e-mail (email_footer); leave empty to hide the link.
Area Secretary: where requests for minutes go (motions and Area meetings pages, and the "not posted yet" lines).

value: Mid-Southern California Area Assembly of Alcoholics Anonymous
notes: Business name to search for in Zelle.
Mileage reimbursement in dollars per mile (37 cents since motion P74-2024-MILE, passed Sept 8, 2024). The expense and budget forms (/service/forms/) multiply miles by it.
The budget year the online Annual Budget Request form (/service/forms/budget/) asks for. Change it (and budget_request_deadline) when the Finance Committee sends out the next year's form.
When budget requests are due to the Finance Committee (YYYY-MM-DD). After this day the budget form says the deadline has passed.
Where the site's files live (owner/repository). The "Edit this page" links point here.

The installable app (README "The app"): on, or off to switch it off. Off stops the app's offline copies and automatic updates on every device at its next visit; an app icon already on a home screen, Start menu or Dock stays and simply opens the website (people remove it themselves). Never delete sw.js by hand: use off.
